newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Canberra approves Air NZ buying into Ansett.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canberra approves Air NZ buying into Ansett.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday that the government had approved Air New Zealand's proposed purchase of 50 percent of airline Ansett Australia.

"Approval, with conditions, has been given today, under the government's foreign investment policy, to the proposal by Air New Zealand Ltd to acquire a 50 percent interest in Ansett," Costello said in a statement.
TNT Ltd is selling the stake to Air New Zealand. But Air New Zealand would not be allowed to take 50 percent of Ansett's international operations, Ansett International Ltd (AIL), the Treasurer said.
"AIL is to be owned 51 percent by an Australian holding company, Holdco, and 49 percent by Ansett (ie, which is to be owned by Air NZ and News Corp ).
"Holdco is to be owned as to 100 percent by Australian persons, as defined in the Qantas Sale Act.
"Where necessary, approval for involvement in Holdco will be subject to normal regulatory processes."
